competitive.name: NTSE
competitive.description: National Talent Search Examination — Class 10. No single official PDF syllabus is published (state-conducted) — use the DIKSHA resource hub.

competitive.name: Science Olympiad
competitive.description: Science Olympiad Foundation (SOF) — official International Science Olympiad sample paper, Class 10.

competitive.name: NMMS
competitive.description: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship — Class 8. Syllabus is set by each state SCERT — no single official PDF, use the DIKSHA resource hub.

competitive.name: AP EAPCET
competitive.description: Andhra Pradesh Engineering, Agriculture & Pharmacy Common Entrance Test — official 2026 Engineering stream syllabus (APSCHE).

competitive.name: TS EAPCET
competitive.description: Telangana Engineering, Agriculture & Pharmacy Common Entrance Test — official 2026 Engineering stream syllabus (TGCHE).

competitive.name: JEE Main
competitive.description: Joint Entrance Examination (Main) — official NTA 2026 syllabus (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics).

competitive.name: NEET
competitive.description: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (UG) — official NTA 2026 syllabus (Physics, Chemistry, Biology).
